plan.title: Prepare and execute clean-checkout CI smoke for the public Web example

criteria.description: CI execution reruns the command even when matching local success exists, preserving actual failure and subsequent recovery.
CI executes independently of human-relayed evidence.
The committed public Web sample remains covered by its contract fixtures; actual remote failing and corrected revision runs must also be recorded before task closure.

limitations: Local tests and smoke do not establish real CI completion. Remote push and workflow execution require separate maintainer approval.
Use GitHub Actions for the minimum sample; no multi-provider templates, deployment, release or settings changes.
Clean sample archives include only committed pack and example sources, never local receipts or relay artifacts.
Pin action commits and explicit Go/Node versions; no local tool installation.
